skill.name: security-audit
skill.description: Security guidance and vulnerability review for codebases, APIs, services, CLI tools, libraries, and daemons. Use for security questions, focused reviews, vulnerability research, security audits, or pen tests. Run the complete workflow only for explicit codebase audit or pen-test requests, full/comprehensive/end-to-end reviews, or requested report artifacts.
skill.summary: Conduct source-first security reviews with trust-boundary analysis, isolated validation, independent verification, and actionable reports.
skill.author: cloudflare

security_audit.summary: All 400 cataloged static matches are false positives caused by defensive documentation, readable validator syntax, or bounded negative tests. The reviewed files show no malicious intent, prompt injection, credential access, obfuscation, or unsafe command construction. Static review was capped at 400/560 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 160 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

content.value_statement: Security reviews often miss trust-boundary failures or produce weak evidence. This skill structures reconnaissance, isolated validation, independent verification, and actionable reporting.
actual_capabilities: Maps architecture, trust boundaries, attack surfaces, and security-sensitive data flows.
Builds a deterministic coverage ledger for scoped, quick, standard, or deep reviews.
Guides focused vulnerability hunting across web, cloud, client, protocol, AI, and memory-safety domains.
Requires bounded local validation before classifying a vulnerability as confirmed.
Uses independent verification to challenge candidate findings and reduce false positives.
Produces structured findings, validation gaps, detailed evidence, and prioritized remediation guidance.
limitations: Full audits require explicit user authorization and an OS-enforced sandbox for target-controlled execution.
The skill cannot confirm controls visible only in deployed infrastructure or external provider settings.
Audit completeness depends on scope, source visibility, available tools, and the user-approved agent budget.
The workflow does not authorize testing production systems, external services, or other users' data.

use_cases.title: Review an application release
use_cases.description: Assess trust boundaries, authorization, data isolation, and deployment-sensitive risks before release.

use_cases.title: Investigate a suspected vulnerability
use_cases.description: Trace a specific claim through source and design a minimal local validation plan.

use_cases.title: Standardize security assessments
use_cases.description: Apply consistent coverage, evidence, verification, severity, and reporting requirements across repositories.

prompt_templates.title: Review one security concern
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [file or component] for [security concern]. Identify the trust boundary, source evidence, impact, and smallest effective fix.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a subsystem
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [subsystem] for authorization, input validation, and data-isolation failures. Keep execution local and report unresolved deployment assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Run a standard codebase audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a standard security audit of [repository]. Use the full workflow, create required report artifacts, and validate candidates in an enforced sandbox.

prompt_templates.title: Run a deep high-stakes assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a deep audit of [repository] within [scope]. Prioritize [critical assets], use independent verification, and document coverage gaps and validation blockers.

output_examples.input: Review the account export endpoint for cross-tenant access.
output_examples.output: The review traces tenant selection, authorization, export assembly, and download delivery. It reports confirmed boundary failures or exact validation blockers.

output_examples.input: Run a standard audit of this service and prepare reports.
output: Coverage ledger with reviewed and deferred units
Verified findings with evidence and focused fixes
Separate needs-validation items for external assumptions

output_examples.input: Check whether this parser crash is a security vulnerability.
output_examples.output: The assessment distinguishes self-impact from a crossed trust boundary, records the observable result, and calibrates severity to demonstrated impact.

best_practices: Define scope, authorization, profile, sandbox controls, and budget before beginning a full audit.
Use dummy data and stop validation at the minimum local effect needed to prove the security outcome.
Require source evidence, an affected principal, a crossed boundary, and independent verification for confirmed findings.
anti_patterns: Do not execute target-controlled code without network, environment, filesystem, and resource isolation.
Do not label missing best practices or unverified deployment assumptions as confirmed vulnerabilities.
Do not test production systems, shared infrastructure, live identities, or external services.

faq.question: When does the skill run the complete audit workflow?
faq.answer: It runs the complete workflow only when the user explicitly requests a full audit, penetration test, or report artifacts.

faq.question: Can it review one suspected issue?
faq.answer: Yes. Guidance mode supports focused source review, triage, methodology, and investigation without creating full audit artifacts.

faq.question: Does it execute repository code?
faq.answer: Only when required controls are available in an OS-enforced sandbox. Otherwise, it records a validation blocker and proposes a safe plan.

faq.question: How does it reduce false positives?
faq.answer: It requires a concrete trust boundary, observable security outcome, bounded validation, and independent verification before confirming a finding.

faq.question: What reports can it produce?
faq.answer: It can produce architecture, coverage, findings, detailed evidence, needs-validation, and run-metadata artifacts for an authorized full audit.

faq.question: Can it assess deployed cloud controls?
faq.answer: It can review source-visible configuration. Provider settings or runtime controls outside the repository remain needs-validation items.
